### Test the features with our free plan
Sign up for our free plan (no credit card required) to try the features for yourself. Upgrade to a paid plan when you're ready to scale.

Twilio SendGrid pricing comes down to two things: how much email you send each month and which features you need. Plans run from a free 60-day trial to Essentials at $19.95/mo, Pro at $89.95/mo, and custom Premier pricing. Volume discounts kick in as you scale.
Each tier adds more as your program grows:
- Essentials: Core sending, tracking, and deliverability tools for smaller programs
- Pro: Dedicated IPs, subuser management, single sign-on, and email testing
- Premier: Custom volume, more email validations, and expert program management

Twilio SendGrid's free trial runs $0 for 60 days and lets you send 100 emails a day — no credit card, no commitment. You get analytics, deliverability optimization, and the dynamic template editor, so you can test the real platform before committing to a paid plan.
Send past what your plan includes and overage charges may apply on top of your monthly rate. If you're regularly pushing your limit, upgrading to the next tier usually beats paying overages. Check your plan details for the specifics.

title: SendGrid Pricing 2026: Plans, Free Trial and Real Costs
snippet:
SendGrid’s Email API costs **$19.95 a month for 50,000 emails**, **$34.95 for 100,000**, and **from $89.95 on Pro**, which adds a dedicated IP. Marketing Campaigns is a separate subscription from $15 a month. Billing is monthly only.
There is no free plan anymore. New accounts get a **60-day trial capped at 100 emails a day**, and sending stops when it ends.

| Plan | Emails / month | Monthly | 12 months (no annual plan) | What the tier adds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free Trial | 100 a day, for 60 days | $0 | n/a | 1 teammate, 1 event webhook |
| Essentials 50K | 50,000 | **$19.95** | $239.40 | Shared IP pool, 2 event webhooks, 3 days of email activity |
| Essentials 100K | 100,000 | **$34.95** | $419.40 | Same as Essentials 50K |
| Pro 100K | 100,000 | **$89.95** | $1,079.40 | 1 dedicated IP, subusers, SSO, 1,000 teammates, 5 event webhooks, 2,500 validations, 7 days of activity |
| Pro 300K | 300,000 | **$249** | $2,988 | Same as Pro 100K |
| Pro 700K | 700,000 | **$499** | $5,988 | Same as Pro 100K |
| Pro 1.5M | 1,500,000 | **$799** | $9,588 | Same as Pro 100K |
| Pro 2.5M | 2,500,000 | **$1,099** | $13,188 | Same as Pro 100K |
| Premier | Custom (recommended from 5M) | Contact sales | Contact sales | 5,000 validations, expert program management |

Two things confuse people. SendGrid’s own pages still say “free plan” in places, and the Marketing Campaigns FAQ still describes a free plan with 2,000 contacts and 6,000 emails a month. New accounts get the trial terms above. Accounts opened through partners such as Azure Marketplace can be on different terms.

- **Dedicated IPs:** Pro and Premier Email API plans and Advanced Marketing Campaigns include one. Each additional IP is **$30 a month**, and the console lets you add one new IP per month (support handles more). Essentials can’t add one.
- **Email Address Validation:** bundled rather than sold to small plans. Pro includes 2,500 validations and Premier 5,000; the trial and Essentials include none. Past the bundle it’s usage-based with volume discounts, and SendGrid doesn’t publish the per-validation rate.
- **Email testing credits** (inbox rendering and spam tests): Pro and Premier include 60 a month. Add-on packs are 30 credits for $18, 60 for $30, 100 for $40, 500 for $200 and 2,000 for $800 a month, and credits expire at month end.
- **Email activity history:** 3 days on the trial and Essentials, 7 on Pro and Premier. A longer history (30 days, bundled with the Email Activity Feed API) is a paid ad
